questions.question: What did Jesus' disciples argue about among themselves at the table?

answers.text: Which of them was the greatest
Which of them should lead the prayer
Which of them should go buy supplies

questions.question: At the Passover table, Jesus told His disciples the one who leads should be like which kind of person?
Jesus told His disciples He was giving them a kingdom. Who had given a kingdom to Jesus?
Peter said he was ready to go with Jesus to prison and death. What did Jesus say Peter would do before the rooster crowed?

answers.text: Deny three times that he knew Jesus
Leave Jerusalem before the sun came up
Go back home to Galilee that night
